They are a bit rough feeling on the outside, but they are very soft and fuzzy on the inside, and seem to stay put better with the cuff turned down, in my opinion. Otherwise, they tend to slide down. This makes them wonderful to wear around the house. The price is a bit expensive for only one pair of cozy house socks that are not really thermal socks, as stated, and are hard to fit when wearing good fitting shoes, but they would make a nice gift.

I absolutely cannot find comfortable glasses frames.  For years, I fidgeted with my glasses...on again, off again...Then I found a pair that were so comfortable that I forgot I was wearing them.  The optician told me that it was because the bridge fit me better than anything I had before.  These are 14 mm, and I had been getting up to 18 mm, with the opticians pinching the bridges closed.  These are made for me.  I entered the 3 specs from my most comfortable pair, and found 3 pairs of glasses that looked perfect!  I purchased 2 (one for this year's glasses, and another for future).  These are the ones I'm having lenses made for first.  Super light weight, and the purple frame color is perfect.  I'm not one of those "purple ladies", and I just wanted something that looked different and flattering.  Bingo!

My family spends a lot of time swimming throughout the whole year whether we are outside or at the indoor pool. We go through a lot of goggles because we demand a lot from them. We, like most, hate goggles that fog up. They make swimming so much less enjoyable since you have to stop and wipe off the fog every five minutes. Thus, having anti-fog coating is a must for our family. Not only do these goggles have anti-fog coating but they also offer UV protection for those summer days.

The goggles came with a plastic storage case, fitting/care instructions, and two additional nose bridge pieces in different sizes. The different sizes of the nose bridge piece allow for a more custom fit. The larger size fit my husband perfectly and the smallest size actually fit my 9 year old daughter. The straps are easy to adjust and didn't tug on my daughters hair like most. The goggles are comfortable to wear as well. The unisex color choice makes them easy to share among the whole family. My husband put them to the test and they didn't fog up or leak the entire time. He was able to see clearly through the water which made his swimming experience more enjoyable.

Pros:
- Comfortable.
- Adjustable nose bridge piece allows for a wide range of size options.
- Color works well for both men and women.
- Do not fog up.
- Do not leak.
- Shatterproof.
- Offer UV protection.
- Straps are easy to adjust.
- Came with a storage case.

Cons:
- The adjustable nose bridge piece is somewhat difficult to change.

Overall, we enjoy these goggles.

I ordered these for use with snowblower / snowstorm / snow removal protection from both sunlight and snow drifts and particles from hitting my eyes while clearing my driveway during storms. I do not ski / have never been a skier.

PROS:

- Very comfortable! Easy to adjust, and they stay in place.
- Definitely protect against bight sun reflection off the snow and UV.
- Definitely protect against snow and particles from hitting my eyes.
- Adjustable strap stays snug whether directly on skin or over other hats and balaclava hoods.

CONS:
- In my experience, such as wearing over my balaclava or along with a facemask, they fog-up despite the adequate venting.

My bottom-line opinion - these are great in the under $30 range and perform great when I'm not wearing a face mask or balaclava or anything that pushes warm air upward from my nose and mouth. But when I'm out there clearing with the snowblower in heavy wet snow conditions and wearing mouth/nose covering, they do fog-up and it's difficult to clear the fog/steam moisture from the lens. I can only guess that for normal Ski usage these are excellent at the price-point.

I needed good protection for some expensive variable reading glasses that have needed repair from abuse that a semi-hard case couldn't handle. This case is much more solid, with a metal body covered by a leatherette-type covering. The interior is a thin felt material that does not come apart under heavy rubbing, so it shouldn't flake off. The metal in the body is heavily magnetic, so I'm guessing some thin steel here, which is good.

The interior dimensions are 6 x 2 x about 1 inch, a perfect fit for my glasses. A little thick for a back pocket, but it'll fit there as well. A three-inch piano hinge across the back gives good stability to the cover when opening; the hinge is covered inside the case by more of the felt material, so no metal-to-eyeglass contact there. The front has a slight indent to make it easier to open.

Case comes with a microfiber cloth for cleaning your specs; it's 5-1/2 inches square and appears to be of good quality.

Overall appears to be a good piece of protection.

This shirt is nice.
Well made. The buttons are functional.
The sleeves are a little like a bell. And they have a rushed detail on the shoulders.
The fabric is thicker than what appears to be in the picture. Is like linen.
The color is easy to pair. A neutral. You can go from casual to work with it.
The fit is weird. I’m using my normal small (135lbs, 34B, 5’5) and it fits good, tighter than what the ad is showing, but it is narrow on the hips. So if you have big hips like me, it won’t go down. Haha.
But it is just that part, because I think if I would go up a size it would be big on me on the top part.
Other than that is a nice versatile shirt.

I happened to get the blue vintage pants shown in the photos of this top. When I had to give the pants to my vintage crazy friend due to being too small, she went nuts when she saw this top. I got the top to go with the pants.

FABRIC
The fabric in this is very soft, and also very wearable. The lace is not picky, a real problem sometimes with lace on tops like this.

COLOR
This is what I would call a soft white or more ivory colored top- which I am THRILLED with. I was hoping it was not stark bright white and it isn't.

STYLE
The style of this top is adorable. If you are not into your bra straps showing you can also get a strapless bra with clear straps added to help with the illusion if you are larger in the bust. Although I could not get a good photo with the top on me, I can say that the fit and appearance is just like the photo shows. It is very beautiful.

SIZING
I expected the top to be too tight like the pants where, but this top runs a bit more true to size. I am a size 14-16 Misses US size so I thought ordering up to a 2X would be good. As it turns out, it is. Unfortunately, the pants that go with this run very small, so I am sending this top along to my vintage friend to wear with her pants. She is nuts about this outfit and I must say it looks AMAZING on her.

BUTTONS
The buttons seem to be spaced well so that they are not pulling apart. This top is supposed to be somewhat looser fitting not fitted or tight, so the buttons should not be pulling anyway.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This top is gorgeous. It fits beautifully, is very flattering, and is comfortable too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS for this top. I like it and if I had the matching pants, I would be tempted to keep it. My friend that is getting it loves it too and it fits her a bit looser which actually looks better.

My daughter is in love with this. It is the cutest bathrobe ever, but we were a little confused at first because it came just folded up as a bathrobe and in the picture it showed it also turning into a plush toy. Turns out there is a secret zipper inside that lets you turn it inside-out and fold the robe into itself, which then zips closed to reveal Doctor Unicorn, an adorably soft plush toy. This wasn't obvious but once you know what to look for, it isn't hard to do. My daughter didn't know it did that, she just loved the robe for being a robe. Once she saw it turned into a Unicorn toy,, she immediately fell head over heals for this and started dancing around the house with it.
I'll be honest, I wouldn't turn it into a plush toy while wet for fear of it getting moldy, but as long as the robe is clean and dry, we're totally going to keep it with her pillows and stuffed animals around her bed. Totally love this product, can't give it enough stars!

The jacket is comfortable and has thermal quality. The basic problem is that it is not windproof as described, rather it is wind resistant. This may sound like I'm splitting hairs but there is a distinct difference. Wind resistant reduces the amount of wind which penetrates the garment but one can still feel the wind. Windproof eliminates all wind penetration and heat loss which accompanies that penetration. I would not reccomend this product below 50 F.

I am pleasantly surprised at how great these are. I love them. Part of my love stems from them being a low ankle sock, followed by overall comfort, and of course the grip on the bottom. I love them for around the house, for keeping my large clunky slippers (ok, really my husbands) somewhat secure on my feet, and for keeping my closed/non hole crocks clogs in place (I'm not a fashionista, but I do have dogs, so crocks are my life!). If you have sneakers that kinda slip or slide, the grips on these will help stabilize your shoe. Perhaps less blisters from rubbing? Other details:

--They wash and dry well. I have washed them in warm water and medium heat. No problems. They look perfect.

--The grip is.. grippy, without being able to feel that material through the sock. It really makes them comfortable to wear as a daily sock.

--I like the solid black color with colorful grips and a band of color at top. They are attractive to me, and definitely feel and wear like quality.

--Lightweight with an arch support band.

--No interior threads to get toenails caught on

--Toe hem sits on top of toes, not at toe nail.

--Slightly longer spot on rear of opening to help pull them on.

--They have never slipped or twisted, no matter what I wear over them (or not wear over them).

I DO recommend them if you are considering this. I have them in my wish list for a future purchase. I love them!

Btw, they are labeled as men's size 6-11, so that would fit women's size 8-13. I have size 10 in women (8 in men), and these fit so very well. Lots of strecth, so they will accommodate.

My last complaint is that the cup inserts are very hard and small and round. Instead of covering your breasts naturally, they create a puffy round circle around the center. They’re just not the right kind of foam or the right size. The overall effect was looking deformed instead of sexy.

If you're a fan of very oversized sunglasses then you'll love these!

They're big, square and very flat. I personally like the look of flatter sunglasses, I think they look stylish. They cover a lot of your face so they'd be great to wear on sunny days with a nice sun hat to match. Theyre great for running errands when you don't want to put makeup on, because no one will be able to tell! You can kind of tell my eyebrows aren't on in the picture but only if you're looking very hard haha

The quality is definitely what you would expect from a $12 pair. The lenses look nice, but the arms look a little cheap and fragile (mainly the gold bits).

If you like the style and want a pair of glasses you don't have to worry about losing, these aren't a bad choice though!

The image on this tee looks exactly like my Persian when she's about to take her nap, so of course I had to order it! It's great for those days when you just need to take it easy - and it's even better if you have a cat to match.
I ordered a size Small. The size chart was a little odd, since it only featured width and length as the measurements. But I usually order Small and decided to give it a shot. My measurements are 34C, 27" waist, and the top was a perfect fit. The material is a bit stretchy so instead of a loose fit, it clings to my curves. It's 95% cotton, but that 5% of spandex makes the difference. If you're looking for a slouchy, sleep shirt look, then you'll probably want to go a size or two larger.

I really wanted to love this pack. I run long distances and love that there are so many pockets for nutrition, keys, phone, etc. The ability to have both water and some type of electrolyte mix in the bottles is awesome. However, if I run more than 8 miles, which I do very frequently, the part around my neck rubs my skin off. I can ignore it for half marathon distance or so, but I would not use this during a 50k or longer race. I need to either figure out how to get it to stop rubbing or find another pack. Adjusting the straps to make it looser or tighter doesn't seem to help. It's too high up on the neck for me.

Had a pair similar to these, might have even been this brand I dont know. When after a few seasons I snapped them on a hike, I knew I needed another pair. I remember they were inexpensive (sub $10), and that the lens were very good at reducing glare but not reducing sight. I also have a thing for the shape of the lens. Some are oddly curved and my eyes get weirded out which makes me feel dizzy. So when I saw these, saw that they appeared to look very similar to my others, and was within the price range I remembered buying for, I figured it was worth the try. So I bought them.

PHEW! They are nearly identical to what I had. Fits my large, wide head comfortably, does not aggravate my eyes, reduces glare, yet doesn't reduce what I see. The dark green lens on these cover my eyes, but are a nice change up from a totally black lens. Comes with a carrying bag, lens wipe cloth, a polarized test card, and a mini screw driver to tighten. ALL in a nice box. Those last few details really upped the experience- I didnt expect the extras. I just wanted my eyes to feel good, look good.. and I got all that and more (without breaking the bank!).

Perfectly fine glass. Not fancy looking, but just what I wanted.

I would recommend this to family and friends as a lovely gift for their mother.

This sweater is thin, so I like to use it for layering on colder days. It does work great for cool days by itself, too (at least with a thin undershirt/Cami, anyway). These days I wear large to x large. I have a large in this sweater, but I think I would have liked an x large better. It fits fine, but it's not as flowy as I'd prefer, especially with the "oversized" description. (Oversized clothes are usually so big that I tend to go with the smaller size, so I don't end up looking extra frumpy.) It's not the softest, but it's not bad. It's the kind of material that's softer on the outside than it is on the inside. It's been comfortable enough for me to wear, though, and I'm picky with what touches my skin. Overall, I do like it for a basic piece. It can be used in a variety of ways. If you want the oversized look, I'd go up a size, though.

I now own several pair of Dudama sunglasses for a variety of looks and purposes and I've found them all to be of good quality, solid build, and durable. I really like these glasses and the fit superb, especially given the very reasonable price. I have a fairly large head but these fit great. The nose bridge is anti-slip and the temples snugly fit the sides of my head. The wrap around is perfect and there is no distortion of my vision while wearing these.

I like the look. It is definitely a racy sophisticated look that goes well with a wide variety of styles. I'd wear these, but so would my sons, and given my 25 yr old son's reaction when trying them on, I may have to make a phone call if they go missing :) . They come in a black bag that feels like a good quality lens cleaning cloth, but the package also includes a small cleaning cloth as well.

The lenses tend to look quite gray on the product listing, but I've found these to be more of a blue. While it's blocking out the harmful rays, it does not leave you with diminished vision and I could see everything quite clearly. They aren't as dark as they look and so you can wear these well into the evening. I wore these into direct sunlight without a bit if problem with artifacts [refractive elements] in the plastic lenses that often plague less expensive [and sometimes even very expensive] sunglasses.

These glasses aren't going to break the bank but they are decent quality and I have no problem recommending them to anyone. I received a free copy for evaluation purposes and an honest and fair review.

They come in a black bag that feels like a good quality lens cleaning cloth, but the package also includes a small cleaning cloth as well.

The lenses tend to look quite gray on the product listing, but I've found these to be more of a blue. While it's blocking out the harmful rays, it does not leave you with diminished vision and I could see everything quite clearly. I wore these into direct sunlight without a bit if problem with artifacts [refractive elements] in the plastic lenses that often plague less expensive [and sometimes even very expensive] sunglasses.

These glasses aren't going to break the bank but they are decent quality and I have no problem recommending them to anyone. I received a free copy for evaluation purposes and an honest and fair review.

This Lovelyduo women's lace party dress runs extremely small. NOT true to size! I ordered a XXL which is my appropriate size and it's so snug it fits like my second skin even though the fabric is stretchy. I would guess this is the equivalent of a size 14-16 perhaps. I wear a size 20-22. So that was disappointing. The dress has a silk sheath lining which is stretchy too. With all the stretch this dress will fit snug regardless. The dress has a v-neckline and the top is see- through. The cap sleeves are just cut off lace which appears to be fragile and easily to snag or fray. The lace is pretty but appears cheap looking and snag easily. Not tastefully made nor classy. Maybe something you'd wear to a sleasy bar kind of dress. No class! Guess it's okay if you're shopping for a man but nothing I'd wear to a cocktail party or wedding. The wine color is pretty. They recommend hand washing and hang dry.

I typically do not wear watches, though when I do it has typically been the less expensive kind that you can find in a department store. My usual limit for spending on a watch has usually been about $35. Burei watches are a lot nicer than what I usually wear but they are not astronomically priced. I have seen several Burei watches and this one has emerged as my favorite so far. It fits me beautifully and it looks very elegant and sophisticated.

This watch has gone with a simplistic approach in design – not too cluttered and concentrate on doing things right. I have had this watch for a week and it has kept perfect time so far, though to be fair it takes months before you can tell if a watch is keeping or losing time. The face has the three basic hands: hours, minutes and seconds. It also has a small dial that tells the hour in 24-hour format. At first I thought this was strictly decorative, but it actually does work and the small hand on it moves through the day.

The face has a cut-out where you can see a small portion of the inner workings. For a better look, take a peek at the back of the watch, though the inner gears are not all that visible regardless.

This is a self-winding watch and through the window on the back you can see the weight that winds the watch as you move. So, while there is no battery to replace, it does mean that if you do not wear the watch for a while it will eventually stop.

The biggest issue I have with the majority of watches I have tried is that they usually do not fit me very well at all. They are either too tight even on the largest setting or I can’t get them to fit at all. This watch has a very generous metal band that fits me nearly perfectly. When closed, and without removing any of the links, the band has enough play in it to allow the watch to move a little bit but not so much that it turns from the top of my wrist. I have huge hands and large wrists so this is not going to work for a lot of people but in the package is a tool for removing links so you can adjust the band to fit properly.

Finally, this is an absolutely beautiful watch. I have received many, many compliments from people when they see it and they ask me about it.

This is a wonderful luxury watch, more upscale than what you will find in a department store and nowhere near as expensive as some of the more expensive brands like Rado or Tag. There are two important considerations when buying a more expensive watch: does it fit and does it keep time. For me, this watch does both and I am very satisfied with it. The fact that it is very attractive is a bonus.

I've only had this a few days but used it quite a bit (we're having a cold snap!) and it's handy and versatile. I like that the neck part is long, so you can either bunch it up like in the picture or tuck the bottom under the collar of your coat and zip your coat up to keep your neck extra cozy. I was hoping the neck piece could be slipped over my nose easily, but with the hood up if just doesn't work well. You CAN, but if the hood is up it makes it bulge out or fall off unless you scrunch up the draw chords (which I think makes your face look like it's poking out out a sphincter). I like that I can flip the hood back and just use the neck part, then just slip the hood back on if my ears get cold - saves me having to stop what I'm doing and look for a hat.
It's of medium quality construction (fine for the price) and very useful for the right weather conditions. It's warm unless there's wind, which seems to cut through it pretty easy and chill my ears. But that also lets the air move so my head doesn't sweat or get over-hot, which is nice. Definitely not the thing for super cold (below 20F) weather or if there's a chilly wind. The faux fur is pretty soft and feels nice, and lines the entire hood and neck (not just around the face like many hoods) which I like.... even though it's not enough to keep the wind out, it does feel nice to wear. It's snug on me and I have a small head for an adult. It'd be cuter if the hood were a little looser. Would be cozy on a kid - definitely not for anyone with a big head.

Overall a fine buy for the money, but it's something I'll use while working outside on cold but not very windy days - I'll definitely choose something else for around town.

I am an RN, and pregnant at that, and noticed the swelling in my feet and ankles would worsen by the end of my 12hr shift, so I decided to try some compression socks. I purchased these cause they were less expensive than the Nabee socks that I saw and purchased and thought to compare them.  Both are 15mm-20mm compression and both were for shoe size 11, and since I'm 6ft tall they both reached me right below my knee.  These nurse mate socks were roomy in the toe area as advertised (as were the Nabee) but I found them a little too snug across my arch area and a little too tight at the top part below my knee. They also didn't really reduce the swelling in my feet much and were not as comfortable as I would've liked. But I'm not sure if its because they were so snug across my arch that the swelling looked worse or what.  In comparison, the Nabee socks were INCREDIBLY comfortable and left my calves and feet feeling massaged and energized the entire shift! I forgot I was wearing them to tell you the truth and at the end of my shift I had NO SWELLING!!  I bought these same Nurse mate socks for my mom who is a Housekeeper in a busy nursing home, on her feet for 8hrs a day 5 days a week, and has started to experience swelling in her legs. The size was the same cause she wears a size 10 shoe but is about 5'5" tall, and she raved about them saying that she doesn't have swelling after wearing them!  So I'm thinking maybe the nurse mates socks are too small for a size 11 and should consider making them in an X-Large size cause the Nabee socks were an XL for my shoe size and they were great!

This simple bag has a reasonable weight to it that I noticed upon receiving. It appears pretty well made and nicely spacious to hold a few basics and some minor additions when on an outing and not wanting to carry a heavier or larger handbag to keep track of throughout the evening. The strap hangs the bag to a nice hip length for awareness of the bag itself but not to the point of being too distracting when in use. The large main pocket can fit a phone and small minimalist wallet and perhaps a small sized lipstick and hand sanitizer without being too bulky looking while the smaller flat outer pocket can keep an ID or some cash on hand without having to dig through the main pocket to find smaller contents. It's a simple little bag for some basics to keep one's hands free.

I should have known better from the price - but the photo looked so good, and I have actually had a great deal of luck buying dresses online....er, until now.
The fabric is a thin sort of gabardine-type polyester material that has no drape and a slightly rough, unnatural-feeling hand to it. The fabric is poor, but the cut and style could have saved it. Alas: the tailoring is as indifferent as the material; it needs expert hands to tailor make it look like the photo. It's a cheap dress that will cost you to get it tailored...so if you order it and don't like it, send it back right away! - don't wait until the return period runs out, because then you'll get stuck with this ugly step-sister of a garment in your closet that is more trouble than it's worth!

I am perfectly willing to accept that we are kind of fussy, but upon taking this dress out of the packaging, my first reaction was that these look like surgical scrubs with bananas all over them. I would think I'm crazy except then my husband wandered over and said the exact same thing. While the fabric does have stretch Inc., there's a weird slickness or lack of flexibility here, and the coloration is definitely reminiscent of scrubs. While the bananas are cute, they don't make quite enough of the statement to overcome that association. The flutter sleeves are nice, and the shape is very forgiving and generous for different body shapes.

The stretches of the kind that it doesn't give until you kind of push it, and then the stretch comes into play. It's not just soft and forgiving everywhere, it's more that if you go to sit down, it does stretch and flex a little bit.

For me personally, I was disappointed in the type of fabric and my daughter didn't care for the feel of it at all. It is well-made and nicely sewn, so if you can get over the fabric, this is a nice enough dress.

The side pockets (while I DO love pockets) hang strangely and make your hips look larger. The material is soft and doesn’t show wrinkles. Quality is as expected. I would recommend sizing down. It would probably work best for thin, less curvy women too.

[[VIDEOID:d2988928d234f06a0c891dc9df76e75]] I am usually very hesitant to buy clothes for my wife because I will either get the size wrong, the color wrong, the style wrong or some combination of those three. A scarf is a safe bet, though, so I selected this scarf with the intention of giving it to her as a surprise. It is a nicer scarf than I expected.

This is a cashmere-blend scarf that is made of some of the softest material I have ever felt in an article of clothing, even softer than a fleece blanket which should say a lot. It has a texture similar to wool but without the scratchiness and without the distinct smell that comes with wool (I like that smell but it's very unique). The tassels are all about 3” long and are all along the short edge.

Unfolded and stretched out this scarf is a little over 2' wide and is about 7' long.

In addition to being so soft, it's well made too. I have found no blemishes in the material and no nits, pills or cuts. The stitching is tight and straight.

This is not an expensive scarf but is far and away better than I hoped. It is exceptionally soft and very nicely made. For once I just might make some points with my wife for picking out clothing for her.

I have 2 of these tails, and they are amazing! They're so much fun to wear, the colors are gorgeous, and the craftsmanship is excellent. I agree with a few of the viewers that the tail tips can wear rather quickly, but the key is to be very careful! Avoid rubbing the hard part of the monofin and the fabric against the rough bottom/sides of the pool. What would happen to your bathing suit if you walked it across the concrete bottom of any pool? A bit of wear and tear!

The good news is that the tailskins can be purchased separately, and YES you can remove the monofin from the tailskin (although, admittedly, it's kind of a pain in the neck). The Mertailor is simply the best in the business- he and his team are professional, courteous, and above all, TIMELY! They get the job done well and they get it done quickly. I've had my tails since last summer and I have a pool at the house, and have used both consistently with no major damage. I've even taken mine to the Caribbean on a cruise and to the local river without any issues! I have two because the first one I ordered (L) was a little too big, so I ended up ordering the medium and now I have a tail to let friends borrow when they come over! Two of my other friends have since ordered their own since they're so much fun! And uh, yeah, we're adults. NO REGRETS!

A bit of wear and tear!

When it comes to technology, I am a utilitarian. In other words, I don't want to spend money on a bunch of features that I don't really need. I remember wearing a watch just like this as a kid during the 1980s, and it served its purpose just fine. It also lasted a long, long time. So when I needed a cheap watch to wear while exercising, I decided to buy the same kind that worked for me all those years ago.

What you get here is a durable and tough watch that will tell you what time it is and beep when it's time to wake up. It'll also work underwater. That's about all it does. If this set of features is what you want, this watch is probably the absolute best value available.

If you like no-frills, plain-and-simple-tried-and-true products, sporting a watch like this is a good way to show it!

It isn't intended for my body type but I decided to risk it. It fits o.k. but not great, no fault of the product. The looooong split almost to my belly button IS a serious flaw as is the diaphanous material. Crotchless is crotchless... THIS THING is split all the way front and back from crotch to the middle. Overall it looks and feels like products costing about half as much from China and I doubt it will last long. If you don't have wide hips skip this one as it just limply lays loose right where wider hips would be. Live and learn. A guy gets away with wearing some of this stuff but I suggest any men eying this move on. This is completely wrong for wide shoulders and narrow hips and has a distinct tissue paper quality to it as well. Update Sep 14: looks better after sewing up the unnecessary length of slit but having to alter a new item is not o.k. and it STILL looks like one of those $0.01 with $9.99 shipping China pieces that go to crap after wearing them twice.

This skirt is a lot longer than the product pic would indicate so I included pictures of how it fit my 5'3" stature. The product description does indicate it is ankle length, but most people tend to pay more attention to the picture. The size small was a perfect fit, unexpected length aside, and the fabric it does have an inner lining so you would not need to wear a slip underneath during the day. It's a well made skirt with an an eclectic look. The fabric is chiffon with gold metallic thread stripes spaced 1/2" apart. It has a graduated hemline that runs from maxi to midi length with a more bohemian styled vibe and would look great with a nice pair of sandals. This skirt would probably be appropriate for an afternoon wedding reception, perhaps on a beach, or lunch at a seaside restaurant. The footwear will determine how dressy or casual you choose to make this look and it can go either way.

I bought these with the intention of using the pocket to hold my insulin pump. For this purpose, this underwear works pretty well.

They're very sturdy and well-made. Definitely not sexy, but as other reviewers have said, more like a full-coverage girdle. Based on other reviews, I ordered a size up, but would order my true size next time as the style is pretty big already and ordering a larger size just meant they go way up over my bellybutton. They're very comfortable to wear, with no riding up or pulling.

As for the pocket, my insulin pump fits in it, but it would fit better if the pocket were a bit lower. If you have a belly, the pump kind of sticks out and can be seen if wearing leggings or a dress that is flat across the stomach. A loose dress fits perfectly without showing anything, so I'm really happy about that.

As the majority of customers will likely be using this underwear to hold money, passport, ID, etc, these work great. Anything flat fits in the pocket and can't be seen. The zipper is also flat, so there's no issue with it snagging clothes. And the colors are bright and fun. You can't go wrong with 12 pairs.

I've worn this twice:  two hot days out in a boat all day (in the middle of a lake in Northern PA).  The day was sunny, I didn't put sunscreen under the poncho, and I didn't burn.  On one occasion, while trying to get onto a float, I ended up in the water and ended up wearing the poncho as I was paddling around.  It didn't try instantly when I got out of the water, but other than the trailing edges it was only damp after an hour back in the sun.  This is a reasonable alternative to a close-fitting rash guard:  it lets more air circulate on a hot day and (ahem) it hides some of my figure flaws.

My review on these sunglasses is based largely on the price point (around $30) and my experience with them in the first few days. As I actually use these more, I will try to update my review.
Unboxing gave a very positive experience on the sunglasses. They came double-boxed and well protected in a well-displayed box (shown in the photo). Also came with a soft sunglasses holder and a cloth to clean the glasses.
I am a bigger guy and have a fairly big head so finding sunglasses that fit is a challenge. These do seem to fit well but could also see them fitting smaller faces as well.
They are reasonably lightweight - about my expectation.
I've worn these several times and they seem durable. i tried putting some stress on them and htey seemed to react well. Will be interesting to see how they hold up well.
Definitely feel like these are a good value for the price.

I have plantar fasciitis and have been trying and using various compression socks and sleeves and arch inserts to help reduce the pain and prevent a recurrence once the pain is gone.

These socks are not only stylish, but they feel great on and actually have compression in the arch area. There is also good compression in the calf area. 

I ordered the small/medium even though I would take a large/extra-large based on their sizing (I take a 9 to 9.5 shoe). I find that these are a bit long as I have to roll the top over to prevent it from coming above my knee. They fit me perfectly, otherwise.   I have several pairs of these socks and have worn their socks all day. It feels great wearing them. I also love the styles they come in.

These are not only "fun" but they are medically helpful for my plantar fasciitis. I wash socks like these in a lingerie bag and lay them flat to dry. Currently, there is no price listed on Amazon for these socks but I would expect them to be priced in the $12.99 to $16.99 range.

Yes, they are worth the extra price compared to other readers.  (And less expensive than prescriptions.)  First, others claim to be "bi-focal" when really they are nothing top, and something bottom.  These appear to be actually something top, and stronger bottom.  The power selected will be at the bottom.  (Note, I'm not certain if all Select-A-Vision are this way.  I've only used Select-A-Vision Optitek Tri-Focus Computer Readers.)  I had a competitor's (FG) that also had actual bi-focals, but they were heavy, pinched my head with strong springs, and so brittle that the first pair snapped in half.  I rejoiced finding these in a store.  They are lighter, a little flexible, and don't pinch -- much more comfortable.  I wish they were more scratch resistant, so handle with care.  The style isn't my first choice, and I wish the lenses allowed more field of vision, but these make it possible for me to use my computer and look up to see the room in focus.  Or to drive seeing the road in focus and the dashboard, too.  I bought my first pair at a computer store, and my work is ordering a pair from Amazon.

Ok, I took a chance on this dress. There was only a few left in the tan color I got, and it was sized a XXL. I don’t normally wear that big of a size. But with the type of dress this is, I figured a if it was a bit big it wouldn’t hurt. Just didn’t want it right on the tummy. Large or XL is what I normally wear, depends on how it’s made, I’m 5’4 and around 170lbs, give or take a few. Size 12 jeans.  I’m not curvy and sort of apple shaped, I have broad shoulders and a bit of a tummy. That being said- this fits me great! It’s a bit baggy at the top, but the straps are adjustable so nothing is hanging out. It’s such a soft material and the bottom skirt part is lined so it’s not see through. The waist is elastic, and has a faux drawstring that isn’t adjustable. Fine with me, it fits perfectly around my middle. I am so glad I got this. And the size I got was on sale too, so I got a great new summer dress at a great price!

nice hiking pants. they are lightweight and comfortable to wear. The material has a light stretch to it making it move with you. The sizing seems pretty much true to size - with a little extra give for movement. You really don't want tight hiking pants for hiking. I have washed these a few times and they wash up just fine - no shrinkage. The lightweight material also makes it great to stash in my backpack on days when I start out in shorts but we either end up having to do some bushwacking or the weather turns chilly - so long pants are needed.  I did not get the convertible pants - the ones that have the legs zip off and they turn into capris/shorts so can't speak to that.

I'm very pleased with this pack. It's not as comfortable as more expensive packs, but for the price and using it for 3-4 days at a time it's a great deal. I am 5'6" and it was pretty big on me, but it fit my boyfriend well; he's 6'2" and 200 lbs. This pack has all of the essentials. The straps are well padded to protect your shoulders and waist from rubs. It has an internal frame so it always stands up straight, which makes it comfy and easier to carry over long distances. If you've got a water bladder there is a pocket to put one in this backpack and a space for the tube to exit the pack on the right shoulder area. This also has a waterproof cover if you find yourself in bad weather.

The internal compartment can be one huge compartment, or it can be closed with drawstrings and divided so you have 2/3rds of the space in the upper compartment and 1/3rd of the space accessible from the very bottom zipper. I use it as one giant compartment because my tent, although light, is very long. The bottom zipper comes in handy because you can access things that are at the bottom of your pack or may have fallen down. I also like that this pack has zipper pockets on the sides of the pack for easy access.

I usually do 3-4 day trips and this backpack is perfect for that. I can fit my tent, sleeping bag, sleeping mat, hammock, small lantern, water bladder, food and clothes in this easily. I would recommend this product and I'm very happy that I purchased this at a promotional rate in exchange for my honest review.

I thought this would be so cute for my standard poodle and I to wear matching gear. Unfortunately, I like his bandana as much as I like my mask!
Both are absolutely adorable, with all kinds of dogs printed on a classic bandana print. And yes, one of them is a poodle, and in my mind it's a standard poodle! You are sure to find a dog that looks like yours. Airedales, dachshunds, and more.
The mask is adjustable to a perfect fit, I find it to be extremely comfortable thanks to the nose wire and adjustable beads on the ear loops. It's a double fabric that is soft and breathable. At least for me, the shape of the mask fits perfectly to my face without a lot of adjusting.
I really like that the package is such that you have to tear the top off. No chance that you're going to get a used product.
Both are machine washable and the bandana can be placed in the dryer on low, but as a personal preference I like to hand wash them, partly because I use a special soap, after all I'll be breathing through it.
Although no filter is included, you can insert one via the sides of the mask.
At this price it would have been nice if they had included just one filter. At the time of this review, this set is being sold for $20. Even without a filter that's not totally outrageous for a custom type print mask and bandana set of this quality
If all of that weren't enough to make you like this product, which by the way is 100% cotton, they also donate to an animal charity.

I like this shawl. It's comfortable and a little like wearing a blanket. The design is lovely, too. For me, it's best for lounging around or walking, but not best for doing any type of activity/chore. If I wear it while I'm trying to do pretty much anything but walk or sit, it gets in the way. The front part will get in whatever is in front of me and it's just plain dangerous to wear while cooking. (I like wearing shawls around my house, just for the extra warmth and modesty, depending on what I'm wearing underneath, but I don't tend to wear them in public.) It's on the thicker side, so it's great for cold days. I've been super happy with it.

I absolutely love the watch. I needed an inexpensive everyday watch and this is perfect. There were other reviewers who complained that it did not keep time properly, but I have not had that issue. I have had this almost a week and it is still keeping perfect time. It is a manual watch which means no batteries and you DO have to wind it. I actually like that idea! The watch looks great and I love the clear front and back to see the gears.

The only reason it is not a 5 star is the watch band is a little big for what was supposed to be a women't watch. I think my wrists are average size and I had to put in another notch since the smallest one was still too big and the heavy watch face would cause the watch to turn around on my wrist. Very annoying for someone who sits and types at a computer all day. Also the watch face was a lot larger than I thought it would be, but I have gotten used to it. If it was too small it would be pointless to have the clear front to see the inner workings.

For the money, it's a great watch! I wind it a little each day and so far no problems. Again, it has kept perfect time since I received it early this week and you just have to remember to wind it.

****UPDATE****
I did love the watch, but the pin broke that winds the watch and changes the hands. The pin is no longer locking properly and therefore the hands are not moving consistently. I am so very disappointed since I really did love this watch when I first got it. I made sure not to over wind the watch and was very careful with it. So, it was great at first, but now it's completely useless. Going to see if I can still return it.

All of the hats we have gotten, my daughter and I have had to learn to share. They tend to be in demand now and then. When this hat arrived, however, I am thinking of hiding it. It is THAT COOL.

WHAT IS THIS HAT LIKE?
This hat is really cool. It is made from what appears to be pressed wool felt. The brim is stiff but flexible. The brim is the color of a nice cabernet wine. The cap is a beautifully formed cap that has an indentation on top that is PERFECTLY set. The band on it is a poly velvet which is tied at the side leaving two nice tails on it. It is a shiny velvet which looks surprisingly classy.

HOW DOES THIS HAT PERFORM?
This hat has been crushed, thrown and sat on and it is still doing great. A little bit of reforming and it looked like new. I don't recommend long term crushing, but it really is a nice hat.

HOW DOES THIS FIT?
I have a head with 21 inch circumference and this hat fits very well. It is not so loose that it will fly off, but it is firm enough of a fit to stay on in reasonable breeze. Winds, well, forget it.

IS THERE WIRE AROUND BRIM?
There is no forming wire around the brim.

IS THERE A BAND INSIDE?
There is a black grosgrain ribbon band on the inside.

CLEANING?
Because this is felted wool, it needs to be carefully spot cleaned. You do not want to soak this with water or squeeze it out if you can help it.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a really cool hat. I have a hard time finding hats with brims that balance well with the crown and flatter me. This hat flattered everyone that has tried it on so far. It is easy to care for and seems to be resilient.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I hope to post a photo of this hat as soon as I am able to. For now, I wanted to at least review this hat and let you all know how much I love it. It goes with several dark red and black jackets that I have as well as other outfits.

What a fabulous, forgiving dress! It is really great for nearly any body type, but perfect if you have a bit of a tummy, or even just a little pooch. It is fitted in the bust & roomy everywhere else, while still highlighting your shape. That's a rare find, especially in a dress online! It does run large. I wear about a US 8 in dresses, give or take (38D, 29", 40") & the small fits well. If you have bigger boobs than I, get a larger size, though. It is snug there, & if I were any larger, it would be unflattering & uncomfortable. I am 5'6" with 33" inseam & it falls exactly at my knees. The material is soft, a bit stretchy, & somewhat thick. No slip needed. Not itchy or irritating in anyway. I really couldn't be happier with this purchase & may even order another color!

One tip - the fabric is thin (but not see through) so be sure to wear a seamless bra under it if you care about that kind of thing.

I contacted the seller just to make them aware of my experience. I made a suggestion that they put the nose rings on a card or something more substantial so they would be easier to find upon arrival. I was not expecting or requesting a resolution. I was surprised to find their response very dismissive, especially when they told me to contact Amazon with any issue. It is my understanding that we are to contact the seller before leaving a less than positive review and make them aware of our experience. So as far as customer service, improvement is needed, in my opinion.

I received these nose rings at a discount or for free in exchange for my honest, unbiased review based on my personal experience.

This set of earrings look nice in the pictures, but even with some of the measured images, it's another story when having the set in person. The setting holding the stones are a bit larger in how they jut out when wearing, plus the post of the earrings are quite long and uncomfortably rest against the back side of the ear when answering phone calls in the office. Also, the silver plating looks poorly done-- granted it is stated that it is silver plated but there have been other silver plated jewelry I've had personally that looked much better. The stones themselves are not quite the same shade of blue when holding them in person, they're a bit lighter by just a bit but you can tell there is a blue hue. They're an okay set for an accessory to match up with clothing or just to wear for fun in general, but for me just sat uncomfortably on my ears due to the long post stems to use for even short term or daily use.

My husband used this (slip over the foot) Leg Wallet for our recent trip to Spain and France. The material is similar to an Ace Bandage and he thought it was very comfortable.  I'm not sure that you'd want to carry your passport (it would get bent due to curve of your leg), but it worked well for carrying cash and credit cards (it has two generous sized zipped pockets). It remained well concealed under his jeans, without creating a visible bump. It was one of several items that we used for this trip, the others being: a Wrist Wallet (I wore this on my ankle), zippered socks, security zippered belt and a bra wallet.  We felt less vulnerable since we were able to spread our cash and credit cards to different parts of our body.

I'm a racquetball player and needed a new pair of court shoes to replace my 7 year old Ektalons. Saw these Jazba's and thought I'd give them a try even though I never heard of the brand before.

My opinions after having them one week and wearing them on the court once so far:

Pros - Good-looking shoes. Well-cushioned. Pretty accurate fit. Well-priced.

Cons - None so far.

Only time will tell how well these will hold up. If they last even half as long as the Ektalons did, then they will merit 5 stars.

UPDATE 3/1/20:. After approx 3 months, I really like these shoes. Good traction. Super comfortable. They look great. Still too early by my standards to change rating to 5 stars, but they continue to impress me.

This purse is super cute (red trim on 3 sides of front and back of bag with red handle and red shoulder strap - see stock photo of the bag I'm talking about attached to this review). However, even though the bottom of the purse is 5" the opening zipper only opens to about 2.5" wide, which makes it impossible to grab a wallet and put it out easily or even without scratching the back of your hand on the zipper.  Not nearly wide enough to open up and look into the bag to find what you need (ie sunglasses, phone, lipstick, pen etc.).  There also is a zippered interior compartment on the opposite side of the interior slip pockets (not mentioned in the description), however with the narrow top opening it is not possible to use this zip interior pocket at all unless you have VERY small hands (even my 11 year old could not reach in easily to the interior zippered pocket).  I was sad this particular style had such a poor design for functionality, because it truly, IMO, is the cutest purse in the line...I LOVED all the extra red!  I ended up with the other purse of a similar size from NAWO - still cute, a bit more golden & black accents; opening still tight/narrow, but I can get my wallet in an out of the one I kept, with much more ease.  Until they fix the top/zippered opening to open wider, I'd personally NOT recommend this bag.

This is an absolutely stunning scarf! I purchased it to wear with my work clothing to give a punch of color and dress things up a bit. I tend to opt for gray, black, and other neutral tones, which is pretty boring. I saw all of the bright beautiful color options available for this scarf and I must admit, it was hard to choose one! The emerald green is GORGEOUS too, but I went with the cobalt blue because I felt it would match more of my current clothing items.

I've been wearing more scarves lately for the reasons above, plus, I feel like it helps me just look more put together over all. I also am slender with a large bust, so I prefer to hide my bust in shirts that are more form fitting, and scarves do that really well. They are also super on-trend right now, so I feel like the scarves just fit right in with everyone else.

I was very pleased when this arrived. It's 100% silk, so even though it says it's a "beach wrap", I don't know that I would want to risk it getting wet. Maybe if I'm just going to be laying out and relaxing in the sun, I might chance it as a cover up, but mainly, I think I will stick to using this for everyday wear. The color is vibrant--absolutely beautiful. It's just like it appears in the picture. I was excited when it arrived because I thought for sure the color would be a bit dimmer, but it's not. The picture is true to the color of the scarf, at least the blue one, which is the only one I can speak to.

I can't say how it holds up in the wash, but I will be dry cleaning this anyway, like I do with all of my 100% silk items. I'm looking forward to wearing this over my little black dresses when I go to summer weddings. It's the perfect accessory.

I've been wearing more scarves lately for the reasons above, plus, I feel like it helps me just look more put together over all. I also am slender with a large bust, so I prefer to hide my bust in shirts that are more form fitting, and scarves do that really well. They are also super on-trend right now, so I feel like the scarves just fit right in with everyone else.

I was very pleased when this arrived. It's 100% silk, so even though it says it's a "beach wrap", I don't know that I would want to risk it getting wet. The color is vibrant--absolutely beautiful. It's just like it appears in the picture. I was excited when it arrived because I thought for sure the color would be a bit dimmer, but it's not. The picture is true to the color of the scarf, at least the blue one, which is the only one I can speak to.

I can't say how it holds up in the wash, but I will be dry cleaning this anyway, like I do with all of my 100% silk items. I'm looking forward to wearing this over my little black dresses when I go to summer weddings. It's the perfect accessory.

This dress has the potential of being really cute.  I was looking for a packable dress to take to Europe.  The fabric is soft and not bulky, also not see-through so I wouldn't need a slip.  For reference I'm 5'3", 128lb, 32DD, and typically wear XS-S in Gap dresses, and a size 2-4 in other dresses, and I think this dress runs a bit large in the waist, but the bust and hips were fine, not tight at all.  The skirt came wrinkled so I don't know that it would have looked good right out of the suitcase, but the material is such that I think in time the wrinkles would ease up.  What broke the deal for me is the uneven stitching around the waist (see pictures).  It made the dress look quite cheap and I will return it.

I loved the design of this ear cuff when I saw it here. Now that I own it, I love to wear it every day. Another plus is that I do not have to clamp it on so tight it hurts as with other ear cuffs I have owned. This cuff fits snug and comfortable and I never even feel it on my ear at all; it does not fall off even though I am very active outdoors. It remains intact on my ear til I am ready to take it off. Earlums is a fabulous vendor as well - they sent along a bonus gift of two more lovely cuffs just to say thanks for my order. I am more than happy to recommend this seller and the beautiful ear jewelry! I own a few other ear cuffs by Earlums and they are equally high quality, beautiful and comfortable. So if you are toying with the notion of getting one of these cuffs, just go for it. The price is more than fair and you will have something lovely to show off!

*****ADDENDUM 8/15/2013*****

I would like to comment further on the high quality of this cuff: last week I was at my boyfriend's house and had a large cup with a lid on it, on top of which I had placed my earrings and ear cuffs when I took them off for the evening. He got up to refill my cup (he's sweet that way!) and when he got to the kitchen all my jewelry slid off the top when he took it off. We found all of it on the floor except this gold cuff (of course, the most expensive one!) and I didn't have the heart to tell him it was my favorite. I simply ordered another one the next day. Well, a few days after that, I was drinking from the same cup and saw something glint in the sunlight. My beautiful cuff was in the cup, immersed in water where it had fallen several days before! And not tarnished a bit. So now I have one for each ear and the satisfaction of knowing that it is indeed real gold; a true testament to its high quality.

Buy this cuff. You won't be disappointed!

I'm glad I purchased them and can't wait until my husband sees me in them!

'You get what you pay for,' as the saying goes. If you want superior, high class earrings that will last, invest in real gold. These 14k gold hoops come with a certificate of authenticity, and you can tell they're extremely high quality. They have a great shine to them and are large enough to be noticeable but not so large they look like junk jewelry. (I ordered the large size, and it absolutely pops out but doesn't overwhelm my face.)
I particularly like them because of the back enclosure. Not studs or loops, but clasps - so they'll never fall out! There's nothing worse than worrying you've lost an expensive earring. I've slept in them, taken them into the shower, and worn them to work without worrying that they'll pop off. They're lightweight and comfy; I don't feel any tugging or discomfort no matter how long I wear them.

This rhinestone tennis bracelet is very cute. I ordered the rainbow bracelet, and the stones were all very nice. I don't think anyone would mistake this for fine jewelry, but it definitely gives a flash of color in stacked bracelets.  While singularly worn might show that it costume jewelry, that effect is diminished when stacked with other bracelets. It stretches enough to fit over the hand and shrinks back to the appropriate size when on the wrist or taken off. The stones were all in place and well-mounted. It is a fun costume piece of jewelry that is very well-made. I do not regret ordering this bracelet.

The main downside is that these appear to be high maintenance. Lots of stuff about how to treat it in the first wash, and possible color leakage… I plan to machine wash cold and dry regardless, because handwashing is simply not gonna happen. I’ll do this first load with blacks to avoid staining anything.

This wallet is so great. I needed a small wallet for a ridiculously tiny purse. I found this after a bit of searching and then wondered what took me so long. I have another one of these in a smooth lighter pink leather that I carry my government ID in for work. I use this every day. I have a larger wallet in my pocket book to carry my less frequently used cards. This one is small enough to put in a pants pocket so a woman doesn't have to take her purse with her. I love the bright pink color. The pebbled leather feels quality and having had another leather wallet by this company for a while I feel certain it will hold up and look good for a long time.

I don't keep much in it. Two cards per slot fits, but makes it feel thick. Also, while the center pouch is zippered, I prefer to not carry change in it. It makes it fat quickly. I like to carry a small amount of folding money, a few credit cards, frequent diner cards, my driver's license and that is about it. It would hold more, but I think it's thinness is it's best quality.

I love the heathernavy color. It will go great with navy leggings. I wear a 38DD, have lost weight, but I think I am almost 41" in bust, almost 36.5" in hips. The medium is still big on me. It is very long, hangs way over halfway between hips & knees if not scrunched up. Since my hips are smaller, I am not sure this will stay up, so I am going to try to shrink it a little. The fabric is so soft & comfortable, not too thin & definitely not see-through like Legging Queen's similar top. This one seems very well made. Yes, the neckline is a little big & you definitely cannot bend over without having a tank or cami underneath, or altering the neckline.  UPDATE: I have run this through 2 dryer cycles very damp & it did not shrink much, is still too long, seems just a couple of inches above my knees. I am thinking about altering the sides to add ruching, so it will stay scrunched up.

I am normally a size10-12 but ordered these in size XXL because I wanted a very loose, relaxed fit for my sleeping and lounging around the house. The fabric is largely synthetic with minimal stretch. It is smooth but not especially soft. The sleeves are extremely tight as are the leg openings on the shorts. I have found the sizing on a great many garments sold here to run extremely small and have found the sizing charts completely useless. My attempts to adjust by sizing up several sizes have not been helpful since the garment proportions are strange. I have a preteen niece who I plan to pass this on to. I won’t be trying my luck with clothing again.

I bought this dress to get married in, and I really liked it at the time. It fit as expected after reading everyone else's comments.

After my wedding, however, I realized that the pattern of the green dress really looked like some of your grandma's drapes. It wasn't very flattering. It's kind of shiny, and it hugged my arms weird, making them look fatter than they really are. You can see in the pictures that it is loose in the chest area above my boobs, and in the back just behind my arms, it does the same thing.

Just order a different dress. It's not worth the money. You will look like you're wearing curtains, and you'll be sad that you chose to wear it for an event you'll remember for the rest of your life.

This dress has a fun elegance, with vibrant colors and a flattering cut. I love wearing it for work, teaching, casual parties, nights out. These are lively colors for fall, spring, or summer, including teal, sage, burgundy, clay-toned orange, brown and black. Little light brown ball tassles embellish the cuffs and the back of the neckline. There's no tag anywhere on this dress, so I'm not sure what fabric it is or where the dress comes from, but I'm guessing it's primarily rayon since it has a brushed-cotton feel, a softness that is not polyester or cotton but feels somewhat natural. We'll see how it washes (will wash by hand and line dry), how much it shrinks, and whether it wrinkles. So far, it drapes nicely over the body; feels soft and comfortable. I'm 5'6" 42-30-37 and bought the 3X (U.S. size 14).

The only slight drawback I can see are the horizontal lines that will draw attention to wide hips or waist. I wish the large orange horizontal rings were positioned a bit higher up on the silhouette, around the waist area rather than hip area. But still, I think it looks great.

The colors of the dress I received are more orange than they appear on the product page photo. I've been wearing the dress with my black leggings and booties but am planning to buy some brown, which would be even more complementary, I think.

By the way, the dress colors and v-neckline go beautifully with this pendant: [[ASIN:B01LF0M11E Tree of Life Pendant 7 Chakra Necklace Wire Wrapped Handmade Birthstone Jewelry Cute Owl Necklace]]. Love the outfit! And you just can't beat the price!

I love this bag! It's a perfect bag, and it holds a ton of stuff. I love the material. It's canvas with many leather strips. The canvas feels like nice denim. I really like the colors, too. The canvas is a brownish purple or black denim color, and the leather is deep brown. The shoulder strap is extremely comfortable, and is reinforces. I like how it swivels, too, so it never twists around the wrong way.

The inside pocket is protected by a zipper and by four outside snaps. This means that nothing is ever going to fall out if you don't want it to. And, inside the inside pocket, it's divided into three different compartments, one of which has an entirely separate zipper. Then, there's another small zip pocket, two pen pockets, and two small pockets. On the outside, there's another zip pocket. Basically, there are tons of ways you can organize anything you want to put in this bag.

The zippers are very high quality, which I always look for in a bag. Most of the zippers have leather handles. It's big enough to fit a small or medium laptop, but a giant laptop probably won't fit. And, the size is great. It looks small on the outside, but it holds a lot of stuff.

Pros:
+High quality zippers
+About ten pockets and compartments
+Feels very nice and comfortable
+Looks extremely attractive

Cons:
-The buckles are just for decoration. There are magnetic snaps underneath.

Over the years, there have been many times when we've been caught in sudden rain. When our kids were in marching band and we were spending our weekends at football games and band events, we got in the habit of keeping disposable ponchos in our backpacks. While these are thin, they are not the super thin ones that rip when opening up. You could potentially reuse it a couple of times before having to dispose of it. Though it may be difficult to fold back up to the small square that it was to begin with! These are definitely nicer than the ones that our kids had to wear over their marching band attire that they were given during inclement weather. These don't take up a lot of room in your bag and are convenient to take with you. I find them especially great for theme parks where similar ponchos are sold for ridiculous amounts of money!

I have an assortment of men in the household with a variety of calf sizes. I am always on the lookout for fun new socks. Let's take a look at these..

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These socks come in a plastic resealable bag. The fabric content is 76% combed cotton, 14% spandex, and 10% elastic. The appearance is supposed to be camo, but it looks more like a grayed mess of colors.

WHAT COLORS ARE IN THESE
These socks have a light gray mixed with red, medium blue, taupe gray, and mustard yellow. The tows and heel are black. The top has a red/gray blend band.

HOW DO THESE FIT?
These socks are listed as large, but they are pretty tight around the top. My spindly leg guys fit them with no problem- sizes 8-10 feet, however, those with large calves forget it. These are WAY too small at the top. Also, I would say that these will not fit over a size 10 mens well.

COMFORT
These socks are comfortable. The guy in the family who has to have cotton socks ended up with these. He will wear them for contracting work. They are comfortable and do breathe well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although these are not the most attractive socks, they care comfortable, have good stretch, but are very small at the top and only for those with feet up to size 10 and very slim calves.

MY RATING
These are nice socks, despite the muddled not very appealing appearance and being a bit tight at the top for larger calves. If you fit the type of person who can wear them, they are pretty nice and even a bit supportive, but if not, well then move to another set. FOUR STARS for this pair of socks. The drab colors almost brought it down to three stars, but not quite.

These socks have a light gray mixed with red, medium blue, taupe gray, and mustard yellow. The tows and heel are black. The top has a red/gray blend band.

HOW DO THESE FIT?
These socks are listed as large, but they are pretty tight around the top. My spindly leg guys fit them with no problem- sizes 8-10 feet, however, those with large calves forget it. These are WAY too small at the top. Also, I would say that these will not fit over a size 10 mens well.

COMFORT
These socks are comfortable. The guy in the family who has to have cotton socks ended up with these. He will wear them for contracting work. They are comfortable and do breathe well.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although these are not the most attractive socks, they care comfortable, have good stretch, but are very small at the top and only for those with feet up to size 10 and very slim calves.

MY RATING
These are nice socks, despite the muddled not very appealing appearance and being a bit tight at the top for larger calves. If you fit the type of person who can wear them, they are pretty nice and even a bit supportive, but if not, well then move to another set. FOUR STARS for this pair of socks. The drab colors almost brought it down to three stars, but not quite.

I ordered this for my husband, yes I’m the wife who picks out clothing.🤭🙄

Let me just say that this shirt gave me mixed emotions.
While I like the material and the way it looked on the model, it has some good and bad points.

Good:
Material is nice and sturdy linen cotton blend.
Has a nice pattern that is subtle.
This type of shirt fits my husband body type,short and stocky.
The fit, well…

It isn’t bad just not sure about the intended body type.
While I like the fit, it is awkwardly tight in certain areas.
The bicep area is a little restrictive, then it tapers by the waist giving a slimming effect. (We like)

However, the bottom of the shirt is loose and I’m not too fond of the buttons and the pattern at the bottom.

If you’re tall and lengthy this shirt will be short. My husband is 5ft7 so it fits him ok.

May want to size up if taller and bigger biceps.

Overall, it’s an ok shirt. 5the value kind of reflects the quality. That’s why the four stars.

The thing I like about this Men's Casual Skinny Polyester Silk Necktie is that it’s fun. I did not grab it thinking it would be a top of the line - or even middle of the line - kinda tie. I got it to wear to be fun and memorable. I liked the dragon and the cool blending of blue and black, knowing it would pop with certain outfits.

From the get-go my wife and I loved the cool look - it does look great in person. The color and the dragon really pop nicely. But it also looks cheaper the closer you get. There are lines in it - texture - that look cool - but while I’m not a tie expert, there is no way this is silk. Polyester, yes, but not silk. I’m also pretty sure it’s just a died/printed on pattern - the wash/care instructions say not to wash and don’t rub too hard - I’m guessing because it would rub the color right off. As you can see from the pics - the back of the tie, the two sides of the material are not even aligned down the center - but are “stitched’ together off to the side. And that little flap on the back - the material is not even colored under there, supporting the color theory. This is NOT an expensive tie. This is a fun tie. This is a wear out, but knowing it probably won’t last long tie. I’ll enjoy wearing it, but no, I’m not expecting longevity. If you go in knowing that, you’ll be good to go.

I decided to give this Men's Casual Skinny Polyester Silk Necktie a 4 star rating because 1. it does look cool in person, 2. I like the design, 3. I went in with certain expectations and they were met, but also it does not rate 5 stars because, 1. it is on the cheap end, 2. the color and design are put on in a way it could easily come off (I’m not going to test, but we did question out loud what happens if the tie gets wet). 3. they barely even tried to line up the material, and 4. it’s not good enough to be 5, but also did not go as low as 3 stars because of... everything above. I felt 4 was fair for what I wanted, expected, and got.

I really can't believe I got these at such a reasonable price. I really wish I could buy this sweatshirt in other designs, but they don't seem to be available anymore...bummer. I would have been willing to pay much more than I did the first time seeing as the quality was so high.

I ordered these Organic Signatures Baby Boys T-Shirts for my wife to customize for my grandson.  They are organic so they are a little more spendy but worth the price.  They are made extremely well and very soft  Also becuase they are organic they don't have any harsh chemical smell that some clothes carry when you first get them.  The sizing is a little weird as it is a 6 - 12 month, they are a bit bigger than a six month top, but would work great for an older or larger baby.  They are a pristine white.  I love the three snaps on the shoulder because with babies you inevitably are changing their clothes multiple times a day.  The snaps make it much easier to pull off a squirmy baby.  I would recommend these without hesitation to other mothers.

Beautiful color, soft fabric, great price...BUT the shirt and pants are sized REALLY weird!!!  Shirt was somewhat billowy, but pants were super small (way too tight and short.  Like, oddly small.)  The bottoms were actually cut in an irregular fashion, which is exactly what I thought I'd received- irregulars.  Wish they'd worked out, but alas, they were promptly returned.  Oh!  Had an issue with return, too.  Ordered two different colors of this set, and they arrived in the same box.  Set up the same return for both pairs, and sent them back in the box they arrived in, both return slips in the box with them.  Of course, I could only use one of the outside shipping labels.  Come to find out, they don't open the boxes to receive each item.  They simply scan the outer label and put the unopened returned package aside.  Refunded me for only one pair and it took some back and forth on my part to get the refund for the other pair, as they had to locate the box in the warehouse and verify the other pair was returned.  It was refunded, but it was a pain.

I LOVE the ease of putting this on and taking it off. I’m a strawberry blonde who comes in two summer colors—white or red—and if I take my kids to the pool by myself, it’s hard to make sure everything gets doused in sunscreen. And that’s a pain, anyway. But this…this beautiful rash guard…I zip it up and away I go. It’s comfortable in the water and not bulky. It’s stood up to my kids hanging on me and a stray piece of Velcro attaching to it in the wash. It was perfect on a slightly chilly day in the pool, because the black cloth soaked in the sun…but I’ve never felt too hot with it on while wet.

Having watched my kids wriggle out of their short sleeve rash guards, I am incredibly thankful I chose the full zip version. Love this thing.

I received this today. The box looked nice, and when I took off the shrink wrap and opened it, it was down hill from there. First of all, that mesh band is only on the TOP of the watch. The underside of the watch is metal links. I have never seen this in my life!  The watch is advertised to "fit a wrist up to 8 inches" and it BARELY fit my 7 inch wrist, that was with some squeezing.  And believe me, I checked the box for extra links. None. Third, this was, in the box and sealed with shrink wrap for who knows how long, was already running, which makes me think that in a few months this battery is going to die and I'm going to be looking for another watch, since it is almost impossible right now to get watch batteries replaced and it would cost more than this watch.  I deliberately chose to get this watch because it comes on Prime so I know it's not being shipped from China.  If this watch were getting a grade, I'd give it a C-

I'm 5'6" 135 lbs.  I read the reviews and decided to get the M and the L to see which fit best.  Many of the reviewers stated that the pants run a little small.  But, I found out, for me, that the Medium fits best.  The Large was a little baggy.  These pants don't fit skin tight like regular yoga pants.  That's exactly what I wanted.  I don't wear them for working out.  I wear them as casual and/or dress pants.  They are really cute with a wedge heel for dressier outings.  I can also wear them with my athletic shoes and they look good. I got the burgandy color and they are spot on in color.  Also, the inseam is 29" which is good for tall girls with long legs.  They might be a tad too long for someone 5'4" or under.

These goggles look really cool! I generally buy whatever I can find in the summer section at the department store so this is new for me. It's crazy how the quality differs. Consider me a reformed buyer.

They come with a great case that is reusable and works great for safe storage. When I opened them I was pleasantly surprised at how high end/professional they looked for the price. The mirrored look on the lenses simply add to this effect. They have a nice tint for when you're swimming outside as well. The straps adjust easily and I really like that they buckle in the back.

I have a disabled daughter who is also asthmatic and has incredibly sensitive eyes. She enjoys swimming (ok, playing and splashing, who am I trying to kid here?) with her classmates twice a week through school. The chlorine fumes at the inside school pool is just too much for her. Her allergies flare up something terrible. These goggles did the trick. They have a nice seal and are comfortable. She has terrible vision (cataracts replaced at 13) but these goggles do not impede her vision any different than usual when she can't wear her glasses. Plus, big bonus here, she looks super cool in her mirrored red goggles! I've already given a link to her teacher who inquired for another student.

So my review may not be from using them in the typical fashion, as an avid swimmer, but they worked great for our needs. I appreciate receiving them from the seller at a discount for my genuine review.

I wanted to love it, but I can’t get the wrinkles out of it.  I have washed it 3 times ironed it while dry, ironed it while damp, allowed it to lay flat to dry, allowed it to hang dry, and they just won’t come out.  I originally thought they must be from the tie dying process, but the inside if the shirt is not dyed.  I can only assume it is a printed fabric and that these wrinkles came from the way the shirt was packaged.  The fabric is different than most shirts as well.  It is smooth on the outside but the inside of the shirt has a rougher knit feel to it.  It’s a comfortable lounge around the house shirt but I wouldn’t have ordered it for that purpose.  I really wanted to love it.  The colors are very pretty and I like the cut/fit of the shirt.  I just won’t leave my house in it since it looks like I just had it balled up in a hamper for weeks on end.  I have tried everything I know to get the shirt pressed except having it professionally dry cleaned, which is recommended on the tag, but I’m not sure I want the expense for what was just supposed to me a casual comfortable shirt.  I hope this is helpful and perhaps you might have better laundry skills than me.  If you buy this and find the secret to the wrinkles, let me know.
