I bought this case not long after buying the Kipling 50 pen case. Which honestly only holds 25-30 gel pens. However, I loved the look and quality of the case, so I bought this one, on sale, and I’m giving it 5 stars because it suits my purpose...not solely for pens and pencils, but art supplies I frequently use.

The outside of the case looks great and feels very durable. The top and bottom of the case are slightly padded, which is nice. The zipper is large and opens easily and doesn’t feel cheap. The little monkey is a cute little addition, although my cat’s hair already stuck to it.

Inside the top there are 14 loops to hold individual pens or pencils. The second “flap” has 12 of the same stretchy loops. In my case, I put my Prismacolor Manga set of pencils in the loops, as well as a blending pencil, and 2 regular pens. When you fold back that flap you get to the bulk of the case, which has no more loops. I’m not sure how many pens it would hold, although I’m guessing from my experience it would not be 100 total (at least not gel pens with clips). The bottom has no structure, so your pens or whatever will be loose. I knew this and that’s why I got this case.

So in the large compartment of the case, I’ve got an array of supplies that I use frequently. I’ve got a couple kneaded erasers, a Prismacolor plastic eraser, 3 small pencil sharpeners, 2 Prismacolor blending markers, a sandpaper block, eraser pen refills, mechanical pencil refills, tortillons and blending stumps, 3 Uni Posca white paint pens, 3 white gel pens, a blending pencil and an Ebony pencil, a pencil extender, a 6 inch ruler and 6 Micron pens, and a couple of regular ball point pens. There is still room for more stuff, but I kind of like it looser so I can rummage around in it easier to find what I need.

Lightweight, generously sized hoodie with plenty of length for my tall 5'10.5" frame. The material has a tight weave, so while it is lightweight the tight weave will help keep out cold and even some rain. Totally fine for lounging around the house, or for wearing under a long coat, or even as a "coat" for those that dont like wearing real coats. Roomy enough to go over other layers. The side elastic pull strings help give it a more fitted look. The zipper goes in both directions for added flexibility in movement. I find the cut and style already helps me with that.

Has pockets (yay!) which arrive lightly sewn. This is not all that unusual. Helps to keep the material to lay flat. Sometimes that occurs with pants too. Just a light snip of thread should help it unravel enough to pull through.

I bought the 2xl, which according to their list is slightly conflicting. It says it fits size 20-22, but then it says fits bust 44.5-46. Size 20/22 is usually more bust size closer to 50, and I think this IS more of a size 20/22. Anyway, I went with the 2XL (size 18/20, size 48 ish bust), and could easily gone down one size. It doesnt look frumpy since the elastic cords allow me to make it more snug. Just just know that this has a forgiving size.

It really met my expectations. It looks like it does in the pictures, and for that I am giving it full 5 star rating. If I experience anything else, I'll be back to update

This is a super cute style of denim dress. The arms are a little long, but when styled as shown with the arms rolled up, no problem. The problem for me was that the fabric is completely inflexible, and the fit is a little bit slim and tight so even my slender daughter seemed like she couldn't quite move her body in this the way she wanted.

The fabric quality and the stitching was very good, but I guess I just expect children's clothes to be cut or have the fabric suitable for play and movement, even when they are fancier clothes. This is something that we would wear to a kids birthday party or really anything except for pictures just because I like my daughter to be able to engage in active play without thinking about her clothing.

Overall, if you are used to inflexible clothing, this will probably be fine, but for my family it was just not the right type of fabric, even though the style is adorable. Also, you should know that there are no loops for the belt, so you'll need to keep a close eye on it so that it doesn't disappear or get lost in the wash.

If you are looking for a Little Black Dress that will travel well and can be dressed up or down, this might be the one for you. The fabric is soft and very comfortable. You can hitch it up a bit if you want to show a lot of leg, or keep it closer to knee length. The material seems to be a cotton blend, but I don't see an indication of fabric content on the tag. It does suggest that you dry clean, hand wash, or if machine washing, hang the dress up to dry. This dress is not the type that has anything built in to compress your flesh, so be aware that it will not hide any bulges. If you have anything you want to hide, you should probably invest in compression undergarments.

This is a cute scarf and hat set. The yarn of this hat and scarf set is much softer than I expected. The stitches are not your usual knit stitches. There are a few stitch loops that look like they have been pulled for a lack of the correct terminology and they stick out a bit further than the tighter stitches. The Due East Apparel Women's Medium Support Mesh Cover Sports Bra is probably one of the best looking sports bra I have ever tried. It looks amazing even though I was sent the incorrect size. However, I am not going to let that detract from the my review of this product because I really like the quality and look. I have a large chest and It would be fine for yoga and low impact exercise, but not supportive enough for running. I ordered a size medium and was sent a size small and was somehow able to stuff myself into it. For reference I am 116 lbs and 36DD. The size small looked like a push-up bra and I was spilling out of it. A medium would have been perfect. The wide elastic band fit my frame perfectly and If I were a B or C cup it would have been fine.

Pro tip: The crossover straps will be challenging if you try to pull it on over your head so step into it and pull it up as you would for shape wear. The inner pads are placed awkwardly and seem unnecessary. You can pull them out and the bra will look amazing.

Each square is about 1-3/8” (3.5 cm), and there is a piece of fabric glued to the back which gives the bead a little more support and should protect your hair from getting tangled with the beads.  My only concern with these earrings is it appears the only thing holding the post section and bottom square together are 2 little threads each with 2 beads and those threads don’t feel very strong.  If this catches on anything like a jacket collar or zipper one of the threads could break and it would not be an easy fix.  Other than that, these are a very nice pair of earrings.

I got these for work at a summer camp that doesn't want counselors to have visible piercings. They work well for the purpose as the clear plastic just blends in with my skin, but I wish these came with some sort of fastener as it's very easy to lose one and not notice. One major strike is that the shipping is ridiculously high, ludicrously more expensive than the product. I cannot believe they actually cost that much to ship, and the shipping cost should not be doubled when ordering an extra set. It's not like two of these tiny plastic parts weigh that much more than one does, and you'd have to order them by the hundreds to make up even a pound of shipping weight. So why are you charging so much for mailing???

I love love love this purse! I got it in dark grey and it's beautiful and really sturdy. It's made of a really thick felt and has a great cut. It's not pictured, but it came with a matching coin purse that's really cute, too. I'm buying a second one in green.

It's good sized, too. I can fit my Kindle, a water bottle, a big wallet, and my phone inside with plenty of room to spare. (See the photo with a water bottle for scale.)

EDIT: I now own the green one as well and it's just as well-made. I've been using these purses daily for many months and they're holding up perfectly, even out in the rain. I'm not sure why other reviewers think it's so small; they must use massive purses. This definitely wouldn't fit over a shoulder but that's pretty clear from the dimensions listed.
